rule: notional = quantity taken best-first from the observed levels (each level at its price); BUY pays the fee in the received base asset (fee = quantity * fee_rate; base += quantity - fee, quote -= notional); SELL pays it in the received quote (fee = notional * fee_rate; base -= quantity, quote += notional - fee). Python gym/domain/sim.py _walk and _settle, Rust exec-core kernel::walk and kernel::settle (ADR 0005).
